asset.label: South Fraser Health Region — horizontal colour logo and tagline, July 2001
asset.sourceLocator: Layout and colours: Supply Chain Exchange, July 2001, PDF page 1 (raster). Outlines: South Fraser Health Region Newsletter, April–May 2001, PDF page 1 (native vector).
asset.dateNote: Publication dates of the two source documents, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: Four-part teal swirl beside “South Fraser Health Region”, a short rule and “Healthy Individuals / Healthy Communities”, left-aligned.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction assembled from original vector parts: the symbol, lettering, rule and tagline are the unmodified native outlines from the April–May 2001 newsletter, each moved (not reshaped) to the horizontal layout of the July 2001 raster at one common scale (fitted overlay, IoU 0.92). No typeface substitution. The rule weight (0.42 pt against 0.24 pt in the newsletter) is measured from the raster. Colours (#1D6A79, #004D5F, #68ACB2, #006878; text #004A5A) are averages of the dithered raster under each part and are approximations; an April 2000 PDF letterhead fills the same four parts with #338C95, #006F7A, #80D4C8 and #00A891.

asset.label: South Fraser Health Region — reversed horizontal logo with Working together for a healthy future, September 1998
asset.sourceLocator: Layout: Strategic Priorities for Change cover (September 1998), thesis Appendix B-7, PDF page 92. Symbol and name outlines: April–May 2001 newsletter, PDF page 1.
asset.dateNote: Cover date of the reproduced document, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: White swirl and “South Fraser Health Region” reversed out of a black panel, with “Working together for a healthy future” in a pen script below.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction. The symbol and name are the native 2001 newsletter outlines, which overlay the 1998 scan as the same artwork (one common scale for both name lines); they are reversed in white on a black panel whose edges are measured from the scan. The tagline is set in Yesteryear (SIL OFL), word by word at one scale, and converted to outlines; the original script typeface is not identified and Yesteryear only approximates it. No tracing. Black and white only, as in the scan.

asset.label: South Fraser Health Region — stacked logo, February 1998
asset.sourceLocator: Board Reference Manual, printed page 19 (February 1998), thesis Appendix B-2, PDF page 87; symbol outlines from the April–May 2001 newsletter, PDF page 1.
asset.dateNote: Date of the reproduced manual, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: Black swirl above “South Fraser / Health Region” in a heavy serif, centred.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction. The symbol is the native 2001 newsletter outline of the same emblem, fitted to the scan (ink spread in the photocopied scan closes the thin white gaps that the vector keeps open). The name is set in Enriqueta SemiBold (SIL OFL) and converted to outlines; the original serif (possibly Friz Quadrata) is not verified and Enriqueta is a stand-in of similar weight and proportions. No tracing.

asset.label: North Shore Health Region — green boxed logo with Sharing a Vision of Health, 1999/2000 annual report
asset.sourceLocator: 1999/2000 Annual Report, cover, PDF page 1 (drawings 99–147; page rotated 270°)
asset.dateNote: PDF creation date (September 8, 2000) of the 1999/2000 report, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: Mountain silhouette, NORTH SHORE, “Health Region” and the “Sharing a Vision of Health” tagline in a green-bordered box; the same design as the November 1999 recruitment advertisement, in colour.
asset.fidelityNote: Original QuarkXPress PDF paths and fills extracted with PyMuPDF; only the page rotation is applied. No tracing, retyping or raster. The green is CMYK 100/0/69/30 in the PDF, written as MuPDF’s RGB conversion (#00805F); white fills are the logo’s own ground.

asset.label: Coast Garibaldi Health — teal symbol and wordmark
asset.publisher: Coast Garibaldi Community Health Services Society
asset.sourceLocator: Geometry: 765 × 246 px greyscale logo inside the Word header object (created June 21, 2000) of the Community Grant Application page. Colours: CGHLogo2000.gif, archived August 13, 2001.
asset.dateNote: Creation date of the embedded Word object; the GIF is a 2001 archive capture. Neither is an adoption date.
asset.notes: Teal disc with white mountain ridges and a sun, six pale bars crossing it, and “Coast / Garibaldi / Health” in a bold italic serif.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction, not original artwork. Disc and bars are geometry measured from the 765 × 246 px bitmap preserved in the society’s June 2000 Word header (circle fit, bar centroids); the white ridge and sun lines are stroked Bézier paths fitted to that bitmap’s skeletonised centrelines, clipped to the disc. The name is set in Gelasio Bold Italic (SIL OFL) with fitted tracking and converted to outlines; the original typeface is not verified. Colours (#00948C, bars #A2C4C4) approximate the 2001 GIF.

asset.label: Simon Fraser Health Region — S symbol, name and region script, monochrome
asset.publisher: Simon Fraser Health Region, Continuum newsletter
asset.sourceLocator: Continuum, January 2001, PDF page 12 (image object 256, 1943 × 990 px 1-bit bitmap)
asset.dateNote: Printed issue date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: Stylized S cut through black blocks beside SIMON / FRASER / HEALTH in spaced capitals, with “region” hand-lettered beneath. The same design appears on the April 1997 letterhead and the 2003 advertisement.
asset.fidelityNote: A vector reconstruction fitted to the 1-bit newsletter bitmap (overlay IoU 0.95). S symbol: straight block edges at measured positions and each curved edge a least-squares Bézier chain fitted to edge points sampled from the bitmap. Name: URW Classico (an Optima design) expanded horizontally to 133.5% with fitted tracking, converted to outlines; the original typeface is not verified. The hand-lettered “region” is an outline fitted automatically to the bitmap contour (disclosed bitmap-contour fitting, not a font).

asset.label: Simon Fraser Health Region — purple and cyan S symbol, name and region script
asset.sourceLocator: Colours: original About SFHR website JPEG, archived August 25, 2001. Geometry: Continuum, January 2001, PDF page 12 bitmap.
asset.dateNote: Archive capture date of the colour JPEG, not a publication or adoption date.
asset.notes: Purple S symbol and capitals with the hand-lettered “region” in cyan, as on the original website.
asset.fidelityNote: The same reconstructed geometry as the monochrome version (fitted to the January 2001 newsletter bitmap; URW Classico expanded to 133.5% for the name, original typeface not verified; “region” fitted to the bitmap contour), checked against the website JPEG at one uniform scale (overlay IoU 0.89). Purple #57046E and cyan #0890AA are averages from the JPEG and are approximations; the JPEG’s capitals render slightly heavier.
